items.title: Malik Washington: Snags short TD in loss to Pats
items.text:
Washington caught five of six targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-19 loss to New England.

items.title: Ollie Gordon: Leading rusher in Week 8 loss
items.text:
Gordon carried the ball 19 times for 69 yards in Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots. He failed to catch his only target.

items.title: Malik Willis: Tosses two TDs in loss to Pats
items.text:
Willis completed 21 of 32 passes for 211 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 24-19 loss to New England. He gained two rushing yards on his only carry.

items.title: DeMario Douglas: Hauls in long TD in win
items.text:
Douglas caught all three of his targets for 76 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-19 win over the Dolphins.

items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson: Racks up 90 scrimmage yards Sunday
items.text:
Stevenson carried the ball 19 times for 82 yards and caught all three of his targets for eight yards in Sunday's 24-19 win over the Dolphins.
